# Cases of jq_diff's .test files where qj on Windows doesn't match jq 1.8.1's
# jq-windows-amd64.exe, and why (.github/jq_diff_windows.py --known). Anything
# else that mismatches fails the windows job.

# lgamma: jq.exe, built with MinGW, has MinGW's own lgamma; qj calls UCRT's,
# which differs in the last digit for these inputs.
corpus/builtins_matrix.test:14062:compact
corpus/builtins_matrix.test:14071:compact
corpus/builtins_matrix.test:14122:compact
corpus/builtins_matrix.test:14131:compact

# qj's own help, usage and version text, which differs from
# jq's by design (jq's with QJ_JQ_COMPAT=1, which isn't supported on Windows).
corpus/cli_meta.toml:help-before-unknown-option:cli
corpus/cli_meta.toml:help-in-bundle:cli
corpus/cli_meta.toml:help-long:cli
corpus/cli_meta.toml:help-short:cli
corpus/cli_meta.toml:usage-from-file-without-program:cli
corpus/cli_meta.toml:version-ignores-jq-colors:cli
corpus/cli_meta.toml:version:cli
